name: github-mcp
description: GitHub (social): me, read_comments, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint

platform_mcp_github_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GITHUB_TOKEN
platform_mcp_github_token.description: GitHub personal access token (fine-grained: repository permission Discussions read / write on the repositories used; classic: repo or public_repo scope) sent as 'Authorization: bearer TOKEN' (https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/guides/forming-calls-with-graphql).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /user returns the token's user {login, id, node_id, name, html_url, ...}.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: Top-level comments of a discussion: `post_id` is the discussion's GraphQL node id (e.g. D_kwDO...; the `id` field of a Discussion, not its number). Discussion.comments is cursor-paginated (first / after): only the first `limit` (max 100) comments are returned and `page` is not honoured; replies to comments are not included. A node id that is not a Discussion yields an empty list.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: the deleteDiscussion mutation permanently deletes the discussion with node id `post_id` and all its comments (needs maintain / admin on the repository or authorship). Failures come back as a GraphQL errors array.

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: Counts for one discussion (node id): comments.totalCount and reactions.totalCount as top-level fields; there are no view counts in the API.
